2608.06416.title: WorldMark: A Plug-and-Play World Knowledge Interface for Cross-Host Language Model Watermarking
2608.06416.paper_summary: Watermarking traces the provenance of text produced by large language models by embedding statistically detectable signals during decoding. Existing schemes fall into logits-based, sampling-based, entropy-aware, and adaptive-strength families, yet all of them place watermark signals according to local token statistics. In the open-ended text-generation settings evaluated in this work, local statistics may provide insufficient guidance for placing robust watermark signals. We introduce WorldMark, a plug-and-play interface that uses World Knowledge Memory (WKM) to organize semantic and episodic knowledge in a memory graph, converts the retrieved knowledge into a token-level knowledge saliency score, and adjusts the strength of a host watermark through Asymmetric Knowledge Modulation (AKM). WorldMark requires no backbone retraining and introduces no additional detector-side model or parameter. On the primary C4 evaluation, the complete WorldMark interface improves clean and attacked detection across three adaptive-strength host variants while slightly reducing perplexity. Additional pilot experiments on C4 and OpenGen show that direct memory conditioning transfers across multiple watermark families but can be unstable without saliency-aware modulation. WorldMark requires no additional detector-side model or parameter and introduces negligible overhead under the primary protocol.
2608.06416.paper_summary_zh: 水印技術透過在解碼過程中嵌入統計上可檢測的信號來追蹤大型語言模型生成文本的來源。現有的方案分為基於logits、基於取樣、考慮熵的和自適應強度幾類，但它們都根據局部標記統計來放置水印信號。在本研究評估的開放式文本生成環境中，局部統計可能無法提供足夠的指導來放置穩健的水印信號。我們介紹了WorldMark，一個即插即用的介面，利用世界知識記憶（WKM）在記憶圖中組織語義和情節知識，將檢索到的知識轉換為標記級別的知識顯著性分數，並通過非對稱知識調製（AKM）調整主水印的強度。WorldMark不需要重新訓練主幹，並且不引入額外的檢測器側模型或參數。在主要的C4評估中，完整的WorldMark介面在三個自適應強度主變體中改善了乾淨和攻擊檢測，同時略微降低了困惑度。在C4和OpenGen上的額外初步實驗顯示，直接的記憶調節可以在多個水印家族之間轉移，但在沒有顯著性感知調製的情況下可能不穩定。WorldMark不需要額外的檢測器側模型或參數，並且在主要協議下引入的額外開銷微不足道。
